player_prompt.intro: Ị na-egwu Tower of Hanoi na diski {num_disks}. Ị ga-ebugharị diski site na ụlọ elu A gaa ụlọ elu C. Iji bugharịa diski, pịnye isi ụlọ elu na ụlọ elu a na-achọ (dịka, '[A C]). Rịba ama na ị nwere ike ịkwaga diski elu nke ụlọ elu, na enweghị ike itinye diski buru ibu na obere diski. Na ntụgharị ọ bụla, nyefee otu mmegharị.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Ị kwuru ebe isi maọbụ ebe a na-achọsi ike na-adịghị mma.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Ị gbalịrị ibugharị diski site n'ụlọ elu tọgbọ chakoo.
invalid_move.same_tower: Ị gbalịrị ibugharị diski gaa n'otu ụlọ elu ahụ.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Ị gbalịrị itinye diski buru ibu n'elu diski dị obere.

game_action.moved: Ị kpaliri diski {disk} site na {source} gaa {target}.

outcome.win: Ekele, I doziwo ihe omimi nke Ụlọ Elu Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: E ruola oke ntụgharị ahụ. Ị debere {pct}% nke diski ahụ n'ụzọ ziri ezi na Ụlọ Elu C.
